_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The Assistant's one URL is /. The server runs in workspace mode, with the Assistant conversation {{ASSISTANT}} and the conversation {{CONV_ID}} (slug {{CONV_SLUG}}). "The header title" is "h1.header-title"; "on the conversation" means the URL path is /c/{{CONV_SLUG}} or /c/{{CONV_ID}}. On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ASSISTANT}}?message_id=m1. 2. The header title should have exactly the text "Assistant". 3. The URL's path and query should come to be exactly "/?message_id=m1". 4. Navigate to /c/{{CONV_ID}}. 5. The page should come to be on the conversation. 6. Navigate to /. 7. The header title should have exactly the text "Assistant". 8. Open the drawer. 9. The element with data-testid "assistant-row" should have an href of exactly "/". 10. The URL's path and query should be exactly "/". 11. Eval: window.history.pushState({}, "", "/c/{{CONV_ID}}"); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent("popstate")). 12. The header title should come to not have exactly the text "Assistant". 13. Go back (the go_back action). 14. The header title should come to have exactly the text "Assistant". 15. The URL's path and query should be exactly "/". 16. Go forward (the go_forward action). 17. The header title should come to not have exactly the text "Assistant". 18. The page should be on the conversation. 19. Navigate to /c/{{CONV_ID}}. 20. Open the drawer. 21. Click the element with data-testid "assistant-row". 22. The header title should come to have exactly the text "Assistant". 23. The URL's path and query should come to be exactly "/".
